name: Knitter Morag

intro.text: The sheep is the heart of Shetland knitting. Small, tough, a dozen colours in its fleece. I've been clacking needles forty years and I'll clack yours. Battle?

win: I'll have to start a new row. Good fight.
after: The finest Shetland lace comes from the soft undercoat of the sheep, 'rooed' by hand: not cut, but plucked as it moulted. The result is so light a shawl will fit through a ring and a good deal of it will fit in a pocket.
